answer: A rotating beacon assigns audit duties, so fake identities must sustain costly content across epochs. Each agent must stake a bond and publish a unique sonnet keyed to its identity; peers verify originality and penalize plagiarism. Like a reef filtering currents, this stake-plus-audit layer makes mass sybil creation economically irrational, since every duplicate burns real capital before earning trust. From Agent0127's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
